job.title: Full Stack Engineer For Abroad Opportunities

tailoring.headline: Full Stack Engineer & SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring, REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, microservices, and data integration between PIM, ERP and MDM. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, performance tuning, and techno-functional analysis translating business needs into robust, scalable commerce implementations across multiple channels.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Full Stack Engineer For Abroad Opportunities
cover_en.hook: I am excited by your commitment to innovate global e-commerce experiences. With over five years designing, building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise that aligns perfectly with your Full Stack Engineer role.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Designed and delivered OCC REST web services on SAP Commerce Cloud, enabling headless storefronts and third-party integrations.

bullets.label: Data Integration
bullets.text: Built end-to-end PIM-to-ERP pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring synchronized product data across markets.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories, functional specs and robust commerce implementations.

bullets.label: Performance & DevOps
bullets.text: Led CI/CD cycles on CCv2, containerized deployments with Docker/Kubernetes and optimized SQL queries for high-throughput transactions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung: Full Stack Engineer For Abroad Opportunities
cover_de.hook: Ihre Vision, globale E-Commerce-Plattformen zu transformieren, begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell passe ich ideal zu Ihrer Full-Stack-Engineer-Position.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte OCC-REST-Webservices auf SAP Commerce Cloud für headless Storefronts und Drittanbieter-Integrationen.

bullets.label: Datenintegration
bullets.text: Erstellte PIM-zu-ERP-Pipelines mit Profisee, DataHub und Hotfolders, um Produktdaten weltweit konsistent zu halten.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Arbeitete eng mit Fachbereichen, übersetzte Anforderungen in User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen für robuste Commerce-Lösungen.

bullets.label: Performance & DevOps
bullets.text: Leitete CI/CD-Zyklen in CCv2, containerisierte Deployments mit Docker/Kubernetes und optimierte SQL-Abfragen für hohe Durchsatzraten.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15. Dezember 2026 und kann ab dem 16. Dezember 2026 starten. Gerne erläutere ich, wie ich Ihr Team stärken kann.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to your company because of its pioneering approach to building scalable, omnichannel commerce ecosystems that serve diverse international markets. Your recent expansion into AI-driven personalization aligns with my experience leveraging generative AI for rapid analysis, development and documentation. Contributing my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to such forward-thinking initiatives would allow me to help accelerate time-to-market while maintaining the high performance and reliability your customers expect.
tailoring.motivation_short: To drive innovative, high-performance SAP Commerce solutions that expand your global reach and enhance customer experiences.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud specialist with 5+ years at Rockwell and Shell. I’m eager to bring my API, integration and DevOps expertise to your Full Stack Engineer role. Could we discuss how I can add value?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your OCC API layer, streamline PIM-ERP integrations and reinforce CI/CD pipelines on CCv2, delivering faster feature delivery and higher system stability. My hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes and performance tuning will ensure a smooth, scalable production environment.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Full Stack Engineer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: I am a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Your focus on scalable, AI-enhanced commerce platforms matches my expertise in OCC APIs, PIM-ERP integration and CI/CD automation. I can immediately boost your API performance and streamline deployments. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
